title: JavaScript actions that declare node20 now run on Node 24 and the Node 20 opt-out stops working
symptoms: Node.js 20 is deprecated. The following actions target Node.js 20 but are being forced to run on Node.js 24: ...
Node.js 20 actions are deprecated. The following actions are running on Node.js 20 and may not work as expected: ...
Older third party actions crash after the runner switch, and self hosted macOS 13.4 or ARM32 runners cannot run them
cause: GitHub hosted runners switched JavaScript actions to Node 24 by default on June 16, 2026, with ACTIONS_ALLOW_USE_UNSECURE_NODE_VERSION as a temporary escape. Node 20 was removed on September 23, 2026, so that escape no longer applies.
fix: Upgrade actions to releases that declare node24, test early with FORCE_JAVASCRIPT_ACTIONS_TO_NODE24, and update self hosted runner hosts.
apply:
env:
  FORCE_JAVASCRIPT_ACTIONS_TO_NODE24: true
# then bump: actions/checkout@v5, actions/setup-node@v5, and other node24 releases
affected: GitHub Actions runners from 2026-06-16 (Node 24 default); Node 20 removed 2026-09-23
